title: [finding] class closure: six more places the runtime dispatcher's `/meta` reads answer differently from `RestServer`'s, measured by #20320's census (unknown type, `?preview=DRAFT`, item translation and doc locale, the book tree, object `?preview=draft`)
body:
Filing gate: **① defects with a named landing site**, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` `handleMetadataRequest`. Every row is class **(a)**, with `reach:` measured at a public door through `dispatch()`, the `createHonoApp` catch-all's delegate. Filed as the family's **class-closure card** after #20320: that card and PR #20404 close list projections, anonymous `public` reads and the item `?state=draft` row.

Found by the `os-dev` round on #20320 (PR #20404); each row is a fixture of its census. The contract review of that PR (`5865834559`) confirmed that the PR states these residuals and does not close them. Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The rows (measured on `origin/main` `b1cbd9277`; each still present after PR #20404)

| # | request | dispatcher | `RestServer` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `GET /meta/totally_invented_type`, signed in | 200 `{items: []}` | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` (`refuseUnknownMetaListType`, the read refusal) |
| 2 | `GET /meta/app?preview=DRAFT`, a `studio.access` builder | the published world | lowercases the value and overlays the drafts |
| 3 | `GET /meta/app/crm`, `Accept-Language: zh-CN` | label `CRM` (no item translation) | `客户管理` (`translateMetaEnvelope`) |
| 4 | `GET /meta/doc/crm_intro?locale=zh-CN` | English label plus the whole `translations` map | collapsed to the locale, `translations` dropped (`resolveDocLocale`) |
| 5 | `GET /meta/book/public_guide/tree` | 404 `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` signed in, 401 anonymous | serves the book tree (ADR-0046) |
| 6 | `GET /meta/object/invoice?preview=draft`, a builder | the active object | the draft object |

Row 2's exact-match parse also sits on the dispatcher's item `?preview=`.

## Read at source, not measured (for the claimant to measure first)

- The dispatcher threads `resolveActiveOrganizationId` for every type, where `RestServer` threads `organizationIdForMetaRead` over the folded type.
- The dispatcher's object mask sets no `Cache-Control: private, no-store` on an undetermined posture.

## The contract

AGENTS.md 〈Route & surface ownership〉 rule 1: one implementation, two transports. Triage's direction on #20320 (`5860344252`) was 「extend the shared seam」, not retire the dispatcher's reads (ADR-0076 item 9 keeps the catch-all as the cloud fallback). PR #20404 builds that seam for the list chain (`createMetaListAnswer` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`). These rows are the item-side and route-side remainder.

## Duplicate check

Searched the board, open and closed:
- 「runtime dispatcher meta item translation locale book tree preview draft differs from RestServer」: 2 hits. #20320 is the parent, closing. #14378 is closed and unrelated.
- 「dispatcher unknown meta type list returns empty instead of 400 refuseUnknownMetaListType」: 4 hits, all closed. #9488 added the REST read refusal row 1 lacks on the dispatcher. #9744, #8421 and #5532 are other `/meta` unknown-type cards.

None carries these rows. #20320, #20237 and #20193 are the family's earlier cards.
